notes.title: A Word on the Future of Hell's Bells (and Games Like It)
notes.content:
Dear players, fans, and the curious,

We're incredibly grateful for the attention and interest that Hell's Bells has garnered since the publication of the store page.

But we want to take a moment to talk candidly about the rocky road ahead.


The Landscape is Changing
If you've been following recent news, you've likely seen that platforms like Steam, Itch.io, and various other storefronts have been applying tighter moderation for this nature of sexual content.

New legislation, like the UK's Online Safety Act, introduces legal and ethical uncertainties for creators of stylized, adult-themed, or controversial art. It's a lot to absorb and we're feeling it too, especially as we've only just begun our journey.


What This Means for Hell's Bells
Hell's Bells was always meant to be more than just a "sexy nun game". It's a tongue-in-cheek satirical world of morality, temptation, guilt, and devotion, wrapped in an unforgiving and original setting.

But with platforms cracking down, we fear that we may need to tone down designs that represent core parts of the Hell's Bells world, even if the game hasn't had a chance to properly flourish.

This is not a cancellation notice, but it's a reality check. We're moving forward with Hell's Bells, and we are not letting this unjustified purge bring us down. 


Why We're Still Hopeful
At its core, Hell's Bells is about resisting control and playing with fire. So yeah, if anything, this climate just makes us more determined to make something unique, wicked, and worth talking about.

We'll continue to share updates, design changes, and honest insights into how this all unfolds. If you're here for the style, story, or the satire... we promise we'll do our damn best to deliver.



If you're interested in the specifics, you can learn more from these sources:

https://www.wired.com/story/steam-itchio-are-pulling-porn-games-censorship/

https://www.gov.uk/government/publications/online-safety-act-explainer/online-safety-act-explainer

https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/articles/c1k81lj8nvpo



If you're here for the aesthetics, the irreverence, or just the vibe... stick with us.

This story's far from over, and we're not done ringing any bells just yet.



With sin-cerity,

— The Hell's Bells Team 🔥

notes.title: 🛠️ Development Update - July
notes.content:
Hey everyone!

The halls are still. The Sisters remain deep in preparation.

We haven’t called for you again, yet, but that doesn’t mean nothing’s stirring.
Small pieces have been moving. Systems tighten. Scenes lock. Ritual paths sharpen. And deep under the cathedral, something hums.



You’ve already glimpsed the cards. Felt the weight of choice. But there are still threads left hanging... [img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45658303/71068cb82c1003abc974c0d9c2e729feb6d2b0eb.png"]


Here’s what’s being fine-tuned:
Dialogue refinements based on internal feedback (yes, she got meaner)

Tweaks to the Ritual System to increase variance on repeat attempts

UI clarity passes, especially around timed decision points

Sound and audio cues are getting a fresh layering of dread



We’re not making noise. We’re making sure that when the time comes, you don’t miss your step.

Wishlist if you haven’t already, or revisit if you’re waiting. The descent is closer than it seems.

— Team Hell’s Bells

notes.title: 🛠️ Development Update - June
notes.content:
Hey everyone!

The work continues. Quiet, focused, and more ambitions than before:

🕯️ Here's what's taking shape:
Unique ritual mechanics for each sister: This will add variety, RNG, unpredictability, and a dash of occult spice to every route you take

Minigames with branching outcomes: This will deepen interactivity, and make the world of Hell's Bells just a bit more perilous

Quick time events: Similar to the minigames, this will bring moments of urgency and quick-thinking to the choices that you make. Choose wisely, and quickly!

Expanded dialog paths: Along with the forementioned rituals, these will bring new and expanded dialog paths for you to navigate



These updates are aimed at making Hell's Bells not just a single experience, but a deep and choice-driven world all relying on your choices.



No major announcements as of yet, but momentum is building!



— Team Hell’s Bells
